text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho ended in victory for 
Narita Taishin. Biwa Hayahide was 
completely overwhelmed by her sheer 
tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she plugs the holes in her "theory," 
she should be able to win next time. Yet 
no matter how many times she replays it in 
her mind, the image of her own defeat 
refuses to fade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is shaken. Beside her, 
Winning Ticket also fires herself up, 
declaring that the Derby is the one race 
she won't give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three clash once again in the Japanese 
Derby. Will there be enough time to 
reconstruct the "theory"...?
